subject: Draft Joint Acceptance Charter & 30-Day Evaluation Workflow
messages:
From: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@novacorp.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: onboarding commitments + evaluation timeline

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our stakeholders liked the latency and cost visibility features — we want a short, executable plan to get an internal eval going. Can you share a template MAP you typically use for a mid-market pilot and a rough 30-day timeline we can review with procurement and engineering?

Key asks from our side: clear milestone owners, an acceptance checklist (tech + privacy), and a procurement checkpoint we can sign off on.

Also include one slide we can drop into a leadership update if possible.

Would appreciate a short GDoc and a slide stub we can iterate on.

Best,
Claire
Claire Bennett
Head of ML Platforms, NovaCorp
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@novacorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding commitments + evaluation timeline

Claire — thanks for the clear asks. Attaching a compact joint acceptance charter (GDoc) and a 1-slide evaluation timeline (GSlides) to start.

High-level approach in the doc:
- Week 0: kickoff + access provisioning (owners: PM + Infra)
- Week 1–2: integration + smoke tests (owners: Eng)
- Week 3: qualitative QA and prompt/quality tuning (owners: Solutions)
- Week 4: acceptance run + procurement signoff (owners: Customer Success + Procurement)

Action items for you: confirm stakeholders (names for each milestone) and whether NovaCorp wants on-prem or hosted sandbox for the 30-day run.

Links to the drafts: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB_MAP_template_stub (GDoc) — please request access if needed.

Irene and Ben are looped in for the technical and procurement checklists below. If helpful, we can lock the doc and run a 30-min alignment on Thursday.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@novacorp.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jul 2025 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding commitments + evaluation timeline

Claire — quick technical checklist I'm adding into the GDoc (short form here):
- API keys & network allowlist (owner: NovaCorp infra)
- Test dataset sample + privacy review (owner: NovaCorp ML)
- Inference config: model variant, quantization, batching suggestions (owner: Redwood Eng)
- Acceptance metrics: end-to-end latency 95th perc < 350ms, token cost estimate per 1k queries (owner: Solutions)
- Rollback/fallback plan if throughput issues arise (owner: Redwood Eng)

I'll paste these into the "Technical Readiness" section and add a one-paragraph description for the slide. If NovaCorp wants an on-prem evaluation we should schedule an engineering sync early next week to scope infra.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@novacorp.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jul 2025 12:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding commitments + evaluation timeline

Adding procurement/legal checkpoint notes for the GDoc:
- Procurement deliverable: signed SOW or PO by Day 28 (owner: NovaCorp procurement)
- Data handling: list of datasets, retention window (we recommend 30 days by default), and KMS needs (owner: both teams)
- Evidence package for SOC2 items (if required): audit log extract, access matrix (owner: Redwood Security to provide sample templates)
- Contract redlines: please flag any non-standard terms early; we can fast-track an internal review with Legal if needed.

I've uploaded a lightweight procurement checklist as an attachment placeholder; put procurement@novacorp.com in the doc for signoff.

-Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Manager, Customer Success Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@novacorp.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novacorp.com, ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 5 Jul 2025 18:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding commitments + evaluation timeline

Thanks, everyone — the draft looks good and aligns with our expectations. A few quick confirmations:
- We will use a hosted sandbox for the 30-day run (no on-prem for pilot).
- Procurement has requested a PO template and the SOW stub; I've attached procurement contact details and will send the PO template by Monday.
- Stakeholders: Claire Bennett (Lead), Mike Torres (ML Eng), Sara Patel (Infra), and Rajesh Iyer (Procurement). I've added them into the doc.

Yes to a short sync on Thursday at 11am PT to finalize owners and lock the plan. Can you send a calendar invite?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Claire
Attachments referenced in thread: redwood_MAP_template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc stub), 30-day-eval-timeline-slides.gslides (Slide stub), procurement_checklist.pdf (attachment placeholder)
